北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感较冷，风力不小，注意添衣防风，别忘了补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels quite cold with noticeable wind. Remember to add layers, stay warm, and hydrate!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感偏凉，风力较大。出门记得多穿点，注意保暖防风。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels cool and windy. Remember to wear more layers when going out and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感微凉。记得带件外套，以免着凉哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to bring a jacket to avoid catching a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温舒适。记得享受美好天气，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and comfortable. Enjoy the lovely weather and stay cheerful!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚，气温宜人。非常适合户外活动，祝你愉快！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is bright and sunny, with pleasant temperatures. Perfect for outdoor activities, have a great time!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感有点凉。出门记得带外套，注意保暖别着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to bring a jacket and stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天体感微凉。注意及时添衣，别忘了多喝水润润。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and feels a bit cool. Remember to add layers and drink more water to stay hydrated.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温适中。出门记得带伞，以防天气变化哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with moderate temperatures. Remember to bring an umbrella in case of weather changes.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感偏凉。出门别忘添衣，暖暖和和最重要。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and feels a bit cool. Remember to add layers when going out; staying warm is key!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感偏凉，空气干燥。注意多喝水，适时添衣保暖哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels cool and the air is dry. Remember to drink more water and add layers to stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温宜人。虽然不冷，也别忘了适度添衣哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast with pleasant temperatures. Although not cold, remember to dress appropriately.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，体感零下。请务必穿暖和，注意防寒保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing cold, with sub-zero temperatures. Please dress warmly and take care to stay protected from the cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阳光虽好，体感依然冷。记得多穿衣物，别冻着了哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but still feels cold. Remember to wear more clothes and don't catch a chill!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，微风舒适。注意防晒，别忘了及时补水哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny with a comfortable breeze. Remember to protect yourself from the sun and hydrate regularly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光正好，微风送爽。气温微凉，记得添衣别着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny with a pleasant breeze. Temperatures are slightly cool, remember to add layers and don't catch a cold.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感偏冷，风力不小。外出务必多穿衣，别忘了防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels quite cold with noticeable wind. Make sure to wear more layers when going out and protect yourself from the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感零下，阳光也挡不住寒意。记得添衣保暖，多喝水哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels sub-zero; even sunshine can't ward off the chill. Remember to add layers, stay warm, and drink more water.
